video.description:
Learn to explain how to set up a SwiftUI navigation screen: Navigation Title, Toolbar & Navigation Destination, with real code, a quiz at the end and each example read twice (normal, then slow).

Today's terms
Navigation Title - The title that a screen shows in the navigation bar.
Toolbar - The bar area where you place buttons for a screen.
Navigation Destination - A modifier that tells the stack which screen to show for a type of value.

Quiz at the end - write your answers in the comments, then watch again to check.

landscape.description:
Explain Navigation Title, Toolbar & Navigation Destination in SwiftUI by listening to a real code chat between two iOS devs.
내비게이션 타이틀, 툴바, 내비게이션 데스티네이션 표현을 영어 대화로 익혀요.

Navigation Title - The title that a screen shows in the navigation bar.
한국어: 내비게이션 타이틀: 화면이 내비게이션 바에 보여 주는 제목

Toolbar - The bar area where you place buttons for a screen.
한국어: 툴바: 화면의 버튼을 놓는 바 영역

Navigation Destination - A modifier that tells the stack which screen to show for a type of value.
한국어: 내비게이션 데스티네이션: 값의 타입마다 어떤 화면을 보여 줄지 스택에 알려 주는 모디파이어

landscape.hook: Can you explain Navigation Title, Toolbar and Navigation Destination in English?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Jake, my notes screen needs a title and an add button.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Set a Navigation Title, like `Notes` in the code.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Where does the Navigation Title appear?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: In the navigation bar at the top of the screen.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Put it in a Toolbar. A Toolbar is the area where you place buttons for the screen.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I put the Button directly in the screen, and it appeared in the middle.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yes. A Button inside the Toolbar goes to the bar. Outside, it is a normal view.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: How do I open a note when the user taps a link?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Add a Navigation Destination for the type of value, like `Int` in the code.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: So the stack knows which screen to show for each value.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Exactly. One Navigation Destination can serve many links.
Set the Navigation Title to Notes.
